Documented SYNTHETIC placeholders — every one of these MUST pass the scanner.
This is exactly the vocabulary the docs use to show a worked example without
leaking a real machine/person.

# tailnet hostnames — angle-bracket, my-tailnet, and tailXXXX styles
angle style:  <mac>.<tailnet>.ts.net
named style:  my-mac.my-tailnet.ts.net
tailXXXX:     my-mac.tailXXXX.ts.net

# home paths
mac home:   /Users/you/projects/sideband
linux home: /home/you/.config/sideband

# email-shaped values
placeholder email: you@example.com
github noreply:    12345+you@users.noreply.github.com
co-author noreply: noreply@anthropic.com
